pie: sóh₂wl̥ deywóns-kʷe h₂nérn̥s spéḱyesi. séngʷs h₁regʷesyét-kʷe stéh₂s léwks-kʷe h₁ludʰés. dyḗm nos stéygʰont sóh₂wl̥ h₂lékse.
english: Sun, you look upon the gods and men. You sank, and it grew dark; you stood up, and light came. Sun, climbing the sky, guard us.

pie: léwke dyéw h₁regʷesyéti. sóh₂wl̥ séngʷt h₂stéres-kʷe stesth₂ḗr. téwe h₂stéres ǵʰlóh₁onti. téwe lówksneh₂ ǵʰlóh₁eti ph₂sdʰí nos. h₂éwsōs téwe dʰugh₂tḗr h₂ew gʷm̥yóyh₁t.
english: Bright Sky, it grows dark. The sun sank, and the stars are standing. Your stars shine, your moon shines. Protect us. May Dawn, your daughter, come again.

pie: dyéw ph₂ter gʰóstis h₁ért só lewbʰós h₁ésti. tósmey déh₃neh₂ h₁opéyomes sédt-kʷe. ḱléwse nos gʰóstim ph₂sdʰí.
english: Father Sky, a guest has arrived. He is dear. We give him gifts, and he has sat down. Hear us, and protect the guest.

pie: péh₂wr̥ h₁yód dʰégʷʰesi h₁yód pékʷesi. h₁yód wódr̥ gʷʰr̥néwsi wódr̥h₂ gʷʰrént. h₁dmé sh₂mé-kʷe péh₂wr̥ nos gʷʰr̥nudʰí.
english: Fire, you who burn, you who cook, you who heat the water! The waters grew warm. We ate and were sated. Warm us, Fire.

pie: h₂éwsos kʷséps téwe swésōr h₁ésti. kʷséps légʰt stéh₂s-kʷe lówksneh₂ séngʷt wiHrṓs-kʷe bʰudʰént. ǵʰlóh₁ontih₂ h₂éwsos gʷm̥sḱési. h₂éwsos nos léwkm̥ h₁opéye.
english: Dawn, Night is your sister. Night lay down, and you stood up. The moon sank, and the men woke. Dawn, shining, you come. Give us light, Dawn.

pie: dʰéǵʰom nos méh₂ter h₁yéh₂ bʰéresi. téwe ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ gʷéHyomes. tetr̥pmé tetl̥h₂dʰí nos.
english: Mother Earth, you who carry us, we sing your famous name. We are satisfied. Hold us up.

pie: pérkune nos méǵh₂ gʷʰóne wékʷos ḱludʰí. h₁yós stonh₂éyesi h₁yós h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰéns. h₁yós wódr̥h₂ spérs ḱlutós h₁ési. h₁ógʷʰis wédn̥su ḱéyto túH-kʷe tóm téwks. nu wódr̥h₂ móri pró gʷh₂ént. nu nos pérkune h₂éǵroysu h₂ur̥sdʰí.
english: Perkʷunos, great striker, hear our word! You who thunder, you who slew the serpent; you who set the waters free, famous are you. The serpent lay among the waters; you struck him, and then the waters went forth to the sea. Now rain on our fields, Perkʷunos.

pie: léwkeh₂ h₂éwsos HéHḱuns h₁éḱwons h₂éǵesi. h₁yéh₂ ḱwinétsi h₁nédʰs léwks-kʷe. téwe h₁éḱwoh₁ sth₂tā́m wiHrṓs-kʷe mudént. h₂éwsos nos méǵh₂ ḱléwos dh₃dʰí.
english: Bright Dawn, you drive swift horses. You who shine, you came forth and became bright. Your two horses stood up, and the men rejoiced. Give us great fame, Dawn.

pie: dʰéǵʰom méh₂ter téwe h₂éǵrom h₂éryomes. h₁yéh₂ dʰoHnéh₂m tḗtḱsi h₁yéh₂ gʷṓs h₂élesi. dʰoHnéh₂ ǵʰelh₃wéh₂ bʰúHt gʷówes sh₂ént h₂éle nos.
english: Mother Earth, we plough your field. You who create the grain, you who feed the cattle! The grain became green, the cattle were sated. Feed us.

pie: méǵh₂ móri méǵh₂s h₁ési. h₁yód wódr̥h₂ gʷr̥h₃ési wódr̥h₂ te h₁ludʰónt. téwe dʰǵʰúHes sn̥h₂énti. móri nos mē gʷr̥h₃és h₂orkéye nos.
english: Great Sea, great are you. You who swallow the waters! The waters went to you; your fish swim. Sea, do not swallow us; guard us.

pie: léwkeh₂ h₂éwsos diwés dʰúgh₂ter ǵʰlóh₁esi. h₁yéh₂ kʷsépm̥ h₂epó h₂éǵesi. h₁yéh₂ dʰéǵʰomn̥s lowkéyesi. h₁yéh₂ sóh₂wl̥ wédʰesi gʷéms h₂stéres-kʷe n̥ḱént. h₂éwsos h₂ew h₁ludʰé sóh₂wl̥-kʷe nos wédʰe.
english: Bright Dawn, daughter of Sky, you shine. You who drive the night away, you who light up the earth, you who bring the sun! You came, and the stars vanished. Come again, Dawn, and bring us the sun.

pie: nu nos deywṓs ḱléwsete. diwés-kʷe ǵʰmés ǵeǵn̥h₁é. h₁yóy h₂nérn̥s spéḱyete h₁yóy h₁wésuh₂ dédh₃te. Hwr̥dʰté pró-kʷe gʷh₂té h₂léksete nos.
english: Now, gods, hear us! You are born of Sky and Earth. You who look upon men, you who give good things! You became strong and went forth. Protect us.

pie: sh₂wéns léwke kʷékʷle skondéyesi. h₁yós póntoh₁m̥ h₁éysi h₁yós gʷʰérmn̥ bʰéresi. h₁yós stóygʰoh₁ lowkéyesi. h₁yód h₂éwsōs h₁ért stéh₂s h₂stéres-kʷe n̥ḱént. kʷékʷle-ge méǵh₂s h₁ési. téwe nos dyéwmn̥ h₁áydʰi.
english: Bright wheel of the Sun, you shine. You who travel the path, you who bring warmth, you who light up the way! When Dawn arrived, you stood up, and the stars vanished. Great indeed are you, wheel. Give us your splendor.

pie: deywṓs n̥smé gʷm̥sḱéte. ph₂térn̥s nos gʷm̥té ǵʰutóm-kʷe ph₃té. tóybʰos-kʷe h₁wésu ḱléwos dh₃té. nu n̥smé h₁ludʰéte sdté-kʷe.
english: Gods, come to us! You came to our fathers, you drank the libation, and you gave them good fame. Come now to us, and sit down.

pie: tod ḱeḱluwōs owis aǵrom ebʰuget.
english: Having heard this, the sheep fled into the plain.

pie: h₂éwsos diwés dʰúgh₂ter h₁yéh₂ h₁rudʰéh₁si. gʷṓs h₁eǵʰ wédʰesi gʷéms spḗr bʰéwdʰt gʷówes-kʷe sth₂ént. h₂nḗr tóns pró h₂éǵeti h₂éwsos tóns bʰérgʰe.
english: Dawn, daughter of Sky, you who are red, you lead the cattle out. You came: the sparrow woke, and the cattle stood up. The man drives them forward. Dawn, safeguard them.

pie: h₁ógʷʰey n̥smé mē sérpes. pérkunos te gʷʰént mr̥dʰí wíse tr̥sdʰí.
english: Serpent, do not creep to us. Perkʷunos slew you. Die! Poison, dry up!

pie: dyéw ph₂ter h₁uséwōm déh₃tōr h₁ési. h₁yós léwkm̥ dédeh₃si h₁yós h₂stérn̥s kʷsépi dʰéh₁s. h₁yós nos wékʷos h₂ḱh₂owsyési. h₁yós deywóybʰos h₁nómn̥h₂ dʰéh₁s. lewkós ḱlutós h₁ési nu nos h₁wésuh₂ duh₃dʰí.
english: Father Sky, you are the giver of good things. You who give light, you who set the stars in the night, you who hear our word well, you who gave the gods their names: bright and famous are you. Now give us good things.

pie: dʰéǵʰom wiHrós mért tóm stérge. tósyo h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm h₁ésti. tósyo ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁syéh₁t.
english: Earth, the hero has died. Protect him. His name is famous. May his fame be imperishable.

pie: deywṓs nos h₂éǵroysu h₂ur̥syéh₁t. dʰoHnéh₂ bʰuh₂yéh₁t h₂óweyes sh₂ih₁ént. dʰéǵʰōm mē tr̥syéh₁t wódr̥h₂ mē n̥ḱyéh₁t.
english: Gods, may it rain on our fields. May the grain grow, may the sheep be sated. May the earth not dry up, may the waters not vanish.

pie: h₁éḱwōs tu wewkond: "ḱludʰí, h₂owey! tód spéḱyomes, n̥sméy agʰnutór ḱḗr: dʰǵʰémō, pótis, sē h₂áwyes h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ gʷʰérmom wéstrom wept, h₂áwibʰyos tu h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ né h₁esti.
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: sóh₂wl̥ te téwe HéHḱuh₁ h₁éḱwoh₁ wéǵʰetes. h₁yód h₂éwsōs h₁ért sth₂éh₁yetām póntoh₁m̥-kʷe gʷéh₂s. h₁yós póntoh₁m̥ lowkéyesi. téwe póntoh₁s lewkós h₁ésti. gʷʰérmn̥ nos-kʷe léwkm̥ h₁opéye.
english: Sun, your two swift horses carry you. When Dawn arrived, they stood, and you went along the path, you who light up the path. Your path is bright. Give us warmth and light.

pie: deywóybʰos nos suHnús ǵeǵónh₁e. gʷíh₃woyh₁t h₂uksyéh₁t Hwr̥dʰyéh₁t. tóm stérgete tósmey-kʷe ḱléwos duh₃té.
english: Gods, a son is born to us. May he live, may he grow, may he become strong. Protect him, and give him fame.

pie: pérkune HéHḱew gʷʰóne ḱludʰí. túH stonh₂éyesi túH ǵʰméy wédos dédeh₃si. túH h₂éǵrons h₂ékʷeh₂h₁ pl̥néh₁si. dʰéǵʰōm térst túH h₂wérs wédos péh₃t dʰoHnéh₂-kʷe bʰwéh₂t. pérkune nos h₂éǵrons h₂ékʷeh₂h₁ pl̥nh₁dʰí.
english: Perkʷunos, swift striker, hear! You thunder, you give water to the earth; you fill the fields with water. The earth grew dry, you rained, she drank the water, and the grain grew. Fill our fields with water, Perkʷunos.

pie: dyéw ph₂ter dweh₂róm póntoh₁m̥ h₁imés. nu nos stóygʰom h₃roǵéye. mē ḱm̥h₂ih₁mé h₂éwsōs nos wédʰoyh₁t.
english: Father Sky, we go a long path. Now make our way straight. May we not grow tired. May Dawn lead us.

pie: (h₁)éḱwōs ewewkʷ, "ḱludʰí, h₂ówi! ḱḗrd h₂gʰnutoy widntbʰós: dʰǵʰémō(n), pótis, h₂wlnéh₂m h₂ówyom kʷnewti sébʰoy gʷʰérmom wéstrom; h₂éwibʰoskʷe h₂wlh₂néh₂ né h₁esti."
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

pie: ḱérd mē tréms deywós te péh₂sti. kʷsép l̥gʰdʰí h₂usbʰós h₁ludʰḗti ḱérd Hwr̥dʰdʰí.
english: Heart, do not tremble. A god protects you. Night, lie down. Dawn will come. Heart, become strong.

pie: wĺ̥kʷe h₂ówins mē h₁r̥sḱés. ḱwón h₂ówins h₂orkéye ḱwṓ bʰéwdʰeti. wĺ̥kʷos-kʷe dedwóye dyḗws te dedórḱe.
english: Wolf, do not go to the sheep. Dog, guard the sheep. The dog is awake, and the wolf is afraid. Sky has seen you.
